name: Creality Falcon2 Pro 22W
tagline: 22W High-power diode with built-in air assist and color engraving gimmick
tldr: Creality Falcon2 Pro 22W is the 22W SKU on the Creality creality falcon2 pro line. Creality's top open-frame diode at 60W combined (22W optical class). Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: 22W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

pros: Creality's popular 22W open-frame tier with factory air assist
Color engraving feature useful for stainless gift marks
Large 400 mm class bed for signs and panels
Structured frame versus budget Ortur-era designs
Strong competitor to S30 Ultra 22W on sale weekends
cons: Open-frame: glasses, exhaust, and kid/pet rules are on you
Clear cast acrylic still needs CO₂
40W tier adds headroom if cutting pays your bills
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 22W module on Creality Falcon2 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Tune cut passes with air assist and focus checks. For photo engraving, slow down vs your cut presets : this head is optimized for throughput on wood, not only finesse.
primaryUse: Cut-biased diode tier for makers who outgrew 10–20W job times but stay on the same frame
mainObjective: Faster cutting and deeper hobby cuts while keeping solid engraving capability

editorialDepth.advantages: Falcon2 Pro 22W targets makers who want Creality ecosystem integration and out-of-box air assist. It is a credible cut-biased diode before CO₂ investment.
editorialDepth.limitations: Color marking is not fiber-depth engraving. Community recipes are thinner than Sculpfun or Ortur. Enclosed apartment buyers should compare Falcon A1 Pro.
